text: The societe.com register page for ACTUAL GROUP (SIREN 510 899 909, Laval) lists Samuel Tual as président since 1 March 2019, and Samuel Tual, Sylvain Richert and Crédit Mutuel Equity SCR as administrateurs.
short: Samuel Tual has been Actual Group's président since 1 March 2019.
